description: Minified source code of clipboard.js v1.7.1, a JavaScript library for clipboard operations with functions for copying and cutting text, managing event listeners, and handling DOM elements related to clipboard functionality.

classes.name: Clipboard
classes.description: Main class for handling clipboard actions like copy/cut, setting up event listeners, and managing fake textareas for clipboard operations.

methods.name: resolveOptions
methods.description: Resolves and sets options such as action, target, text, container, trigger, and emitter.

methods.name: initSelection
methods.description: Initializes the selection process, either by creating a fake textarea to copy text from or by selecting an existing target element.

methods.name: selectFake
methods.description: Creates a hidden textarea element with the text to copy, selects it, and prepares for copying.

methods.name: removeFake
methods.description: Removes the fake textarea element from the DOM.

methods.name: selectTarget
methods.description: Selects the specified target element's content for copying.

methods.name: copyText
methods.description: Executes the copy or cut command to copy selected text to clipboard.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Emits success or error events based on the copy operation result.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears any text selection, refocusing the trigger if available.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and fake elements.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Getter and setter for the current action ('copy' or 'cut').

methods.name: target
methods.description: Getter and setter for the target element to copy from.
